free_text: The patient is a 62-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 6.1 and a prostate adenocarcinoma diagnosed as Gleason 3+4 (ISUP Grade Group 2) in the transition zone. MRI showed a PI-RADS 4 lesion with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. Given the Gleason score and patient comorbidities, the management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
